integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained after the source definitions. Exact membership of each monomial slice follows from an elementary disk supremum, and the original starlikeness/local-univalence threshold follows from the derivative and logarithmic derivative. The global obstruction follows from the explicit decay of the source multiplier. No numerical sampling or finite search is used to prove the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: The negative inverse-preservation result is for the full normalized analytic preimage class associated with the specified algebraically damped Hadamard multiplier and disk target. It does not preclude positive inverse-preservation theorems after imposing additional coefficient, sign, sparsity, or regularity hypotheses. The exact positive thresholds are proved for individual monomial slices, not for arbitrary multi-mode finite-dimensional slices.
title: Every positive disk target admits a high-mode inverse-univalence counterexample
